Effective classification is evaluated at read/list/search/history/reveal/context/review.list/Record Event/provenance boundaries. Superseded/archived assertions are not exempt.

Remote Knowledge Record Events are withheld when either the stored event classification is restricted or the current assertion effective classification is restricted; provenance resolves only through visible events.

Evidence linkers take evidence FOR SHARE while source-classification/availability maintenance takes FOR UPDATE. This closes the concurrent-link race, while dynamic read-time aggregation remains the security backstop.

For bounded availability/classification maintenance (default fan-out ceiling 128 linked live assertions), control rows may be synchronously marked revalidation_required. triggers.logic: SELECT * INTO head FROM knowledge.knowledge_assertion_predicates WHERE predicate_code = NEW.predicate_code ORDER BY predicate_version DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE; IF NOT FOUND THEN IF NEW.predicate_version <> 1 THEN RAISE check_violation; END IF; RETURN NEW; END IF; IF head.admission_state = 'retired' THEN RAISE check_violation ('a retired predicate_code is closed; use a new code'); END IF; IF NEW.predicate_version <> head.predicate_version + 1 OR (NEW.value_type, NEW.cardinality, NEW.temporal_semantics, NEW.qualifier_rule, NEW.allowed_subject_kinds, NEW.allowed_entity_types, NEW.canonical_owner, NEW.normalization_rule, NEW.fingerprint_version) IS DISTINCT FROM (head.value_type, head.cardinality, head.temporal_semantics, head.qualifier_rule, head.allowed_subject_kinds, head.allowed_entity_types, head.canonical_owner, head.normalization_rule, head.fingerprint_version) THEN RAISE check_violation ('predicate structure is immutable within a predicate_code'); END IF; RETURN NEW;

notes: Head = max(predicate_version) per code; a retired head closes intake for that code permanently.
